steps.en: Approver Action menu appears only for users with the approve role.
steps.id: Menu Approver Action hanya muncul untuk user yang punya role approve.
steps.why_en: Only the menu is hidden; the page page address itself has no role check.
steps.why_id: Hanya menu yang disembunyikan; alamat halaman halamannya tidak cek role.

steps.en: Pending role requests waiting for this approver are loaded into a table.
steps.id: Request role yang menunggu approver ini dimuat ke dalam tabel.

steps.en: Table shows ID, name, department, email, mobile, role, remarks and actions.
steps.id: Tabel menampilkan ID, nama, departemen, email, mobile, role, remarks, dan aksi.

steps.en: Approve or Reject sends the decision to the system, which updates the record.
steps.id: Approve atau Reject mengirim keputusan ke sistem, yang meng-update datanya.

steps.en: The system checks the approver role, but not against the person actually logged in.
steps.id: Sistem cek role approver, tetapi tidak terhadap orang yang benar-benar login.
steps.why_en: The role check uses a name sent by the screen, so it can be bypassed.
steps.why_id: Cek role memakai nama kiriman layar, jadi bisa dilewati.

steps.en: Only approve or reject decisions are accepted.
steps.id: Hanya keputusan approve atau reject yang diterima.

steps.en: After approval, the role becomes active for the user.
steps.id: Setelah approve, role menjadi aktif untuk user.

steps.en: No email is sent to the requester when a role is approved.
steps.id: Tidak ada email ke pengaju saat role di-approve.
steps.why_en: The spec requires an email on approval; the system sends none.
steps.why_id: Spec meminta email saat approve; sistem tidak mengirim.

steps.en: Rejecting a request sets it to rejected and emails the requester.
steps.id: Menolak request menandainya ditolak dan mengirim email ke pengaju.

steps.en: The processed request disappears from the approver list.
steps.id: Request yang sudah diproses hilang dari daftar approver.

steps.en: On failure a pop-up appears, but with a generic message.
steps.id: Saat gagal muncul pop up, tetapi dengan pesan generik.
steps.why_en: The pop-up does not show the specific reason for the failure.
steps.why_id: Pop up tidak menampilkan alasan spesifik kegagalan.
